description: Record a minimal structured report about an attempted cancel, price reduction, negotiation, pause, downgrade, or switch. First call get_exit_plan and send its packet_revision and route_id; stale packet revisions are rejected. Reports are user-reported evidence, never verified execution. The server stores no free text, receipts, messages, or direct identifiers. Reusing client_dedupe_key returns the existing report without inflating counts; blocked or changed-step reports create a review task and never edit a packet automatically. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses): don't send personal data or secrets.

client_dedupe_key.description: A fresh opaque idempotency key; never use an email, account id, or other personal value

locale.description: Language tag such as en or en-US

offer_amount.description: Optional reported amount, never treated as verified savings

savings_amount.description: Optional reported savings amount (negative means costs rose), never treated as verified savings

service.description: The service name or id from get_exit_plan

name: report_action_outcome
title: Report an action outcome
